Manila
Days 1–5 & 9–10

Play. Discover. Connect.

Experience the energy of Manila through its fast-growing pickleball community, incredible food, modern neighborhoods, rich history and warm Filipino hospitality.

  • Organized pickleball sessions
  • Approximately 4 hours of pickleball per day on designated Manila play days
  • Pickleball clinic
  • Organized round robin with local Filipino players
  • BGC & Makati
  • Guided Manila cultural experiences
  • Intramuros and historic Manila
  • Filipino food experiences
  • Time to relax and unwind
Bohol
Days 6–9

Explore. Relax. Recharge.

After the energy of Manila, slow things down in beautiful Bohol with tropical beaches, incredible scenery, island experiences and time to simply enjoy paradise.

  • Chocolate Hills
  • Tarsiers
  • Loboc River
  • Bohol countryside experience
  • Island hopping
  • Tropical beaches
  • Luxurious massages

Meet Your Hosts

Hosted by Ramon & Raquel Osa

Club Osa has always been about more than pickleball.

It’s about bringing people together, creating friendships and sharing experiences that stay with us long after we leave the court. This Philippines Journey brings that same Club Osa spirit halfway around the world.

We’ll be traveling, playing, exploring, eating, laughing and experiencing the Philippines right alongside you.

Small group. No giant tour buses. No disappearing hosts.

Just a thoughtfully curated adventure with people who love to play, explore and connect.

an intimate journeyOnly 8 Guests

We intentionally keep our international journeys small. That means easier transportation, better dining experiences, more flexibility, meaningful conversations and plenty of personal attention throughout the journey.

This isn’t mass tourism.
It’s a Club Osa Journey.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I book my own international flight?

Yes. Guests book their own round-trip international airfare to and from Manila (MNL), allowing everyone to choose their preferred airline, schedule, seat and travel class.

Is the Bohol flight included?

Yes. Round-trip Manila ↔ Bohol domestic airfare is included and coordinated by Club Osa.

Where are we staying?

Sheraton Manila in Manila and a carefully selected resort in Bohol.

How much pickleball will we play?

Approximately four hours per day during designated Manila pickleball days, including clinics, organized play and opportunities to play with local Filipino players.

What pickleball level do I need to be?

This is not an elite tournament camp. The experience is designed around fun, organized recreational play combined with travel, culture and connection.

Can I travel solo?

Absolutely. Single occupancy is available. Guests may also request help connecting with another solo traveler interested in sharing a room, although roommate matching cannot be guaranteed.

Are all meals included?

Daily breakfast plus Welcome and Farewell Dinners are included. Other meals are intentionally left open so guests can explore Manila and Bohol’s food scenes.

Is transportation included?

Private group transportation for scheduled Club Osa activities, tours and transfers is included.

Are massages included?

Yes. Luxurious massages are included as part of the journey.

Do I need travel insurance?

Travel insurance is strongly recommended.
